title: IntegralIdealProperCohomology
statement: Let f:X -> T be proper with T affine and its global-section ring R Noetherian. Let i:Z -> X be a closed immersion with Z integral, and let I be an ideal sheaf given by Z.IdealSheafData. For every q >= 0, H^q(X,i_* I) is a finite R-module, where the R-action is restriction of scalars along f.appTop.

source.place: Tags 02O5 and 01YH, integral-support part of the proof

proof.text: Derive Noetherianity of X from the affine Noetherian base and proper finite-type morphism. Prove all three finiteness implications in the long exact sequence, simultaneously in every degree, by Noetherian finite-submodule and extension arguments. For the first term in degree zero use its injection into H^0 of the middle term. Prove zero and isomorphism invariance, and induction on finite subobject filtrations in Lean.

Induct over closed subsets of X using WellFoundedLT on Closeds X. For an integral closed image choose the Chow module G with finite cohomology and generic rank one, then use the geometric comparison. The zero branch has finite cohomology. In the other branch every cokernel filtration factor is an ideal on a strictly smaller integral closed image. The induction hypothesis and finite-filtration induction give finite cohomology to both cokernels. The first short exact sequence transfers finiteness from G and Q1 to K; the second transfers it from K and Q2 to the given ideal. Specialize the simultaneous-degree conclusion to q.

theorem finite_H_pushforward_integral_ideal {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) [IsProper f] [IsAffine T] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (I : Z.IdealSheafData) (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (((pushforward i).obj I.toModules).H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ f.appTop.hom
    Module.Finite Γ(T, ⊤) (((pushforward i).obj I.toModules).H q)
